method.blankSampling: every 16 ms: visible part of pages without a finished bitmap

optimized.note: Single-pane trials use the final source. Dual-pane trials were measured with the render queue built as PdfRenderQueue(2, 0) under an intermediate version that still had a visible-slot reservation parameter; with 0 reserved it schedules exactly as the final PdfRenderQueue(2).

fallbackSmoke.note: Raster requests answered 503: the browser renderer draws; one trial

excluded: Two earlier optimized runs were discarded: a shared build chunk moved the worker client so its __dirname-relative worker path broke, every raster request returned 404, and the reader measured the browser fallback. The script now fails a trial on any non-200 raster response.
